context: Data team sprint 22. Dan leads. Team: Hana (data engineer), Eli (analyst), Zoe (data scientist). The nightly pipeline must finish by 6 AM; this week it failed 3 times. Dashboard v2 launch is planned for the 14th. The cloud budget alert is at $2,000 per month; last month cost was $1,700. Dan owns the contact with the data vendor DataPipe; the credentials request is pending. Dan has the reviews for the churn model waiting.

lines.text: morning everyone quick round hana you first

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: morning so the nightly pipeline failed again last night that is now four times this week
my notes say three can you check the log

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: oh maybe three the fourth was a manual run anyway the cause looks like a bad join on the orders table

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: i also need the credentials from data pipe to test the fix
i own that contact i will chase it

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: my turn i am waiting for the new dashboard numbers and i am not sure which version of the churn metric is the final one
i will confirm in the channel which churn metric is final

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: thanks also can you review my query today
yes i will review it after standup

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: the security scan came back with one critical finding on the upload service
who owns that ticket

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: so the churn model accuracy is at ninety two percent but i think we can get more
nice zoe

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: also we cannot launch the dashboard on the fourteenth because the metric is not validated
what is missing for the validation

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: a week with the finance team to compare numbers

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: coffee anyone i am going to the kitchen

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: yes please

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: not for me
two sugars for me

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: dan can you send me the finance contact
sure i will send it after standup

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: by the way what is a canary release i saw it in the notes
it means we give the new version to a few users first

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: also the cloud costs are higher this month nearly two thousand
last month was seventeen hundred so we are close to the alert

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: dan who gets the pipeline alert at night
let me sort that out in a minute first anything else

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: random thing i am thinking about changing the team lunch day to thursday
lets talk lunch after standup

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: i will send the fix for the join by tomorrow
and i will send the updated launch plan today

lines.speaker: Zoe
lines.text: so who takes the alert tonight
hana tonight and i am the backup

lines.speaker: Eli
lines.text: and the launch date
we decide after the validation with finance

lines.speaker: Hana
lines.text: sounds good
thanks all
